JOIN STRATEGIES IN SPARK
Whenever we write Join statement in spark these joins
will be implemented by spark internally in multiple
ways/strategies.
Spark primarily have 5 joining strategies/ways
¢ Sort Merge Join Strategy
¢ Shuffle Hash Join Strategy
¢ Broadcast join strategy
¢ Broadcast Nested loop Join Strategy
¢ Cartesian Product Join Strategy
This choice of Join Strategy will be decided by spark
automatically but understanding them helps to optimize
the spark job performance in better way
The Choice of selecting join strategy depends on
© DataSize (smaller or larger table)
* Skewness in data
¢ Distribution of data (how data is partitioned across executors)
¢ Optimization Goal (minimal shuffling, memory usage)

BROADCAST JOIN STRATEGY
Broadcast join is a join strategy that is supposed to be used
when we have one small table and with large table
In Broadcast Join, the smaller data table will be
broadcasted to all the worker nodes of larger data table.
Broadcasting the smaller data table to all partitions/
workers of big table will reduce the data shuffling and each
worker can perform join locally
Let's see how a broadcast join works
Suppose you have two data files to process -
file1 - 6GB (Big file)

File2 - 1GB (Small file)

both these files has been partitioned on as

filet -3 partitions 2GB each on 3 executors/workers
file2 - small file no partitions
